dedupe_keys.name: geolocation of the irrigation network and water user associations of klambu wilalung irrigation district indonesia

description: This dataset gives the geolocated irrigation network in the operation areas of water user associations in the Klambu Wilalung irrigation district, Central Java, Indonesia, and is described in a Data in Brief article. It covers GPS tracks for seven primary and 75 secondary canals and waypoints for 194 irrigation structures of 12 types, obtained from irrigation officials and turned into shapefiles in QGIS and Google Earth, together with survey data from 2016 on 34 water user associations under community-based or provider-based network governance. Coverage is Grobogan and Kudus regencies. The data are provided with the open access article under CC BY 4.0. Caveats: the network is limited to the operation areas of the surveyed associations, and the association data date from 2016. Simulation uses: canal network topology and structures for irrigation distribution modelling and governance studies. Related records: GRAIN, a global registry of irrigation networks (data-grain-global-registry-agricultural-irrigation-networks), and SIGRIAN, the Italian irrigation information system (data-crea-sigrian-italy-irrigation-information-system).
